## Overview

::: {.callout-note}
### Slide Navigation
The interactive lecture slides are built with Quarto and Reveal.js. Use arrow keys (`←`, `→` or `Space`) to navigate slides, `F` for fullscreen, and `O` for slide overview mode.
:::
